conn.bannerBody: Sends already running continue in the service; the window reconnects by itself.

details.title: Details
details.none: Nothing sent to the service yet.
details.sourceNote: Nothing is read yet: the files are counted once you choose the destination.

source.title: What do you want to send?
source.intro: Drag files and folders onto the window, or pick them.
source.countLater: The total (files and GB) is counted in the analysis, once the destination is chosen.
source.readOnly: filebridge only reads the source: nothing there is ever moved, renamed or deleted.

dest.title: Where to?
dest.intro: Choose a saved destination or create a new one.
dest.newHint: Local folder, SFTP server or Nextcloud
dest.etaLater: The estimated time appears once the files are counted.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.tooBig: Not enough free space: {size} to send, {free} free at the destination.
analysis.scanErrors: {n} item could not be read | {n} items could not be read
analysis.reopened: Job reopened from the list: the counts are the saved ones.
analysis.noIssues: No name problems: everything is sent as it is.

nfc.title: {n} name with decomposed accents | {n} names with decomposed accents
nfc.explain: Fixed automatically: the accents are rewritten in the composed form (NFC). The text looks the same; the bytes change.

nextcloud-nfc.title: {n} name Nextcloud would not find | {n} names Nextcloud would not find
nextcloud-nfc.explain: Fixed automatically: Nextcloud only indexes names in the composed form (NFC).

forbidden-chars.title: {n} name with characters the destination refuses | {n} names with characters the destination refuses
forbidden-chars.explain: Fixed automatically: < > : " \ {'|'} ? * and control characters become _.

trailing.title: {n} name ending in a space or dot | {n} names ending in a space or dot
trailing.explain: Fixed automatically: the trailing spaces and dots are removed.

reserved.title: {n} reserved Windows name | {n} reserved Windows names
reserved.explain: Fixed automatically: names like CON or COM1 get a prefix.

nextcloud-reserved.title: {n} name Nextcloud reserves | {n} names Nextcloud reserves
nextcloud-reserved.explain: Fixed automatically: names like .htaccess are renamed.

collision.title: {n} name that would clash with another | {n} names that would clash with another
collision.explain: Two names become the same at the destination. Decide which one changes.

encoding.title: {n} name that isn't valid UTF-8 | {n} names that aren't valid UTF-8
encoding.explain: The original bytes can't be read as text. Decide how to send them.

issues.editTitle: Choose the name at the destination

review.title: Review & send
review.renamesValue: {n} name, all decided | {n} names, all decided

modes.nextcloud: Nextcloud (direct mode): files are copied, then Nextcloud indexes them

review.verify: Verify by checksum at the end
review.verifyHint: Compares the SHA-256 of every file at the source and the destination. Slower, but proves the copy is identical.
review.safety: Copy only: the source is never changed or deleted. Closing the window doesn't stop the send.

after.title: Sending
after.closeOk: You can close the window: the send continues in the background and you'll get a notification when it ends.
after.verifiedAll: Every file was verified: source and destination are identical.
after.failures: {n} file with errors | {n} files with errors

nextcloud.permissions: Setting owner and permissions in Nextcloud

jobDetail.title: Job
jobDetail.logNote: Events received while this window was open.
jobDetail.cancelStops: The send stops for good and can't be resumed.
jobDetail.cancelKeeps: The {n} files already sent stay at the destination.
jobDetail.cancelNoDelete: Nothing at the source or the destination is deleted.
jobDetail.cancelFinal: To send the rest later, start a new transfer.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.deleteNoFiles: No files are deleted, at the destination or anywhere else.
destinations.deleteJobs: Jobs that used it keep their history, but can't be resumed without it.

kindsHint.local: A disk or folder on this computer
kindsHint.sftp: A server or NAS over SSH
kindsHint.nextcloud: Direct mode: Proxmox LXC over SSH

profile.name: Name
profile.noPassword: Key or SSH agent only; the server's host key must already be in known_hosts. Password login is not available in the window yet.

nextcloud.intro: filebridge connects over SSH to the Proxmox host, finds the Nextcloud container and checks each step. Nothing is changed during detection.
nextcloud.ncUserHint: the account that receives the files
nextcloud.pickContainer: More than one container looks like Nextcloud. Which one?

settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationsHint: System notification when a send finishes or fails.
settings.later: Bandwidth limit and schedule arrive in a later version.
settings.serviceHint: filebridge-service does the sends; the window only shows them. It starts by itself when needed.
